user.title: Connect to Lidarr
user.description: Enter the address you use to open Lidarr in a browser, including any base path (for example `{example_url}` or `{example_proxy_url}`). The API key is under Settings → General in Lidarr.

data_description.url: Lidarr's web address, including the base path if you use one.
data_description.api_key: Found in Lidarr under Settings → General → Security.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only if Lidarr uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Lidarr
reauth_confirm.description: Lidarr at {url} rejected the API key. Enter the current key from Settings → General.

data_description.api_key: Found in Lidarr under Settings → General → Security.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Lidarr. Check the URL and that Lidarr is running.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.not_lidarr: The server answered, but it is not Lidarr. Check the URL and port.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Lidarr instance is already configured.

data_description.max_albums: How many albums the albums sensor lists (1–50). Raise it if the card shows several rows.
data_description.max_artists: How many artists the artists sensor lists (1–50).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Lidarr for new items, in minutes.
data_description.albums_enabled: Turning a sensor off also stops its API calls and events.
data_description.artists_enabled: Turning a sensor off also stops its API calls and events.

data_description.link_url: Only needed if Home Assistant connects to Lidarr on a different address from the one you open in your browser, for example an internal IP address instead of a reverse-proxy name. Used for the links in the sensors and events. Leave empty to use the connection URL.

error.invalid_link_url: Enter a full web address for links, starting with http:// or https://.
